verdict.rationale: Orb docs confirm accrued cost/revenue tracking before invoicing (orb-docs-4), configurable usage-threshold alerts for product-led growth (orb-docs-6), and real-time webhooks for event notifications (orb-docs-23), covering the core alerting/real-time-visibility ask. missing for 10: explicit evidence of a customer-facing self-serve usage dashboard and independent/hands-on confirmation that alerts reliably fire before invoice generation.
